question: Who among the following started the Kuchipudi Art Academy at Madras (now Chennai) in 1963?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Vempati Chinna Satyam.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vempati Chinna Satyam started the Kuchipudi Art Academy at Madras (now Chennai) in 1963.**
 
• **Vempati Chinna Satyam:**
 
 
• Born on **October 25, 1929, in Kuchipudi village in Krishna district.**
 
• The Kuchipudi dance originated in the same place.
 
• Chinna Satyam strove to popularise the unique dance form across the world.
 
• He began dancing at the age of six.
 
• Over a period of two decades received training from famous teachers such as **Tadepalli Perrayya Sastry, Vedantam Lakshminarayana Sastry, and later from his elder brother Vempati Pedda Satyam.**
 
• He founded Kuchipudi Art Academy in **Chennai, in 1963.**
 
• He trained hundreds of students at the **Kuchipudi Art Academy in Chennai.**
 
• Branches of this academy were later established in cities such as Visakhapatnam, Mumbai, and Calcutta in India and several cities in the USA.
 
• His students include veteran actors and dancers like **Hemamalini, Rekha, Vyjayanthimala Bali, and Manju Bhargavi of 'Shankarabaranam's fame.**
 
• He also gave performances in over** 60 countries.​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Nataraja Ramakrishna:**

 
 
• Dance guru Nataraja Ramakrishna used the dance poses carved in this temple to revive Perini Sivatandavam, a Kakatiya-era warrior dance form performed by men.
 
 
 
• **Raghavayya:**
 
 
• He was an accomplished Kuchipudi dancer, who was awarded** "Bharata Kala Prapurna" in dance by the Andhra Pradesh government.**
 
 
 
• **​Shanmukha Srinivas:**
 
 
• He is an Indian actor and Kuchipudi dancer who primarily works in Telugu cinema.
